plane.attitude_source: dip 9.5 deg measured on GMS 04-02 cross-section A-A' (scripts/measure_gms_section.py); dip direction fitted to the Jp/Jps (first-flow top) trace, which runs beside both sample reaches (A-G4)

fold.formula: S(x,y) = a x + b y + c + delta(u); u = (p - origin) . down_dip; delta = control_delta[0] for u >= control_u[0]; cosine blend between successive control points; control_delta[-1] below the last. Offset surfaces: S + off / cos(local dip).
fold.note: Cylindrical (strike-parallel) flexure fitted so the modelled first-flow base honours the mapped Jf/Jp and Jo/Jf traces as well as the Jp/Jps trace, with the paper's thicknesses; dip 9.5 deg at and NW of GBR (both sample reaches), flattening between the reaches and the Feltville valley, then steepening toward First Watchung as the GMS section draws (A-G4).
